subject: my mother had a bad turn on her tablets
body_text:
Hello,

My mum has been taking Glucostat for her diabetes and since last week she keeps getting very dizzy and had a fall on Tuesday. She is 79. I am worried it is the tablets.

Should she stop taking them?

Janet
